At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.



Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.



Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.


**Tide facts:**


* Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members: 900,000 UK and 1,100,000 in India and growing rapidly
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* Over 2,800 Tideans globally

jobs.title: Associate Product Data Manager
jobs.description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.


At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate , serve as a compass in our decision\-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.


**Associate** **Product Data Manager \- Private Markets Content**

We’re looking for a Product Data Manager / Owner to join our team of software and AI/ML engineers as we build out a future\-ready company data foundation.


Our team lives within the Content Refinery unit which provides the most comprehensive and connected inventory of client, proprietary and third\-party content in the industry. The Content Refinery produces a suite of connected content with extensive data hierarchy and taxonomy. Our team represents the company data master which is leveraged by our internal partners to build next\-generation workflows for our clients.


You’ll be joining the Entity Intelligence Team which is responsible for defining, collecting, and building modern systems to curate data via agent\-led processes, 3rd\-party data and other internal FactSet teams. This data powers the products that all FactSet clients use to analyze their investments in Private Companies (e.g., sourcing, due diligence, and fundraising).


**Role Description:**
---------------------

As the Product Data Manager, you will convert business strategy and client needs into the vision that powers our data and a product roadmap and work closely with our AI/ML Engineering teams, Claude (and other AI tooling) and legacy systems to execute on that roadmap.


You will work with internal stakeholders to understand the content expansions that will create the most impact for our clients and then translate them into the overall vision. You will then help break down the vision into a roadmap of themes, epics, stories, bugs, and acceptance criteria. That overall vision will guide our AI/ML team in building the models and pipelines that identify and structure this content to make the most impact for clients.


**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

### **Defining your Work:**

* Translate stakeholder needs into a backlog of work to be refined into user stories that state the functional expectations and reasoning for how it impacts our clients.
* Provide thought leadership by understanding how our internal and external clients plan to use our content and anticipate the future content they will need.

### **Maximizing Value of your work:**

* Continually focus on and rank what is most important to deliver next. (e.g., prioritize Jira stories that are most important to deliver next according to their business value, dependencies, overall strategy, and team availability)
* Make visible all the work that needs to be completed by your team to deliver major features and deliverables from the backlog.

### **Tracking Progress of your work:**

* Define and report metrics to provide transparency for progress against the product roadmap.
* Surface or anticipate hidden project risks and develop contingency plans to mitigate those risks.
* Synchronize with other product owners and internal team leads to identify obstacles and dependencies, working to remove them through negotiation and escalation.
* Communicate with Stakeholders, other Product Owners, and Engineering teams to ensure the vision and goals for Private Markets Content is understood. Ensure buy\-in is achieved on all major decisions.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

* 5\+ years of data product management experience on a data team or similar role managing content data sets.
* Team player attitude with a strong desire to learn about Private Markets, modern data tooling and matrix organization structures.
* A keen interest to learn from and work with engineers to apply AI/ML to real world data.
* A solid understanding of financial valuation
	+ Understand and derive Market valuations: e.g., identify peer groups, market multiples, industry betas, capital structures, and business models for various groups of industries.
	+ Use or derive financial models, vendor data (FactSet, etc) and/ormarket research to assess viability and growth potential of private companies
* General knowledge of data environments (warehouses, lakes, pipelines, mapping, ETLs...).
* Analytical skills and data driven mindset that can be hands\-on when needed with data analysis (Excel, PowerQuery, PowerBI, SQL)

**Highly Desired**
------------------

* Experience in Agile software development, working directly with software and data science engineers
* Financial analysis and financial modeling skills: adept at reviewing and parsing financial statements e.g. income statement, balance sheet, and statement of cash flows
* Experience with structured transactions, banking, consulting, analytical experience in a specific industry.
* Experience in due diligence, have a view on a company. Invest/Not Invest, identifying potential acquisition targets for large corporations
* Comfortable with ambiguity and dynamic environments while understanding process and constraints of a large organization.
* Ability to make decisions quickly and remove ambiguity for the team to help them move faster.

**Company Overview:**

FactSet ( NYSE:FDS \| NASDAQ:FDS ) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy\-side and sell\-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more…

Who Are We?
  
  

For 115 years, L’Oréal, the world’s leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world.
  
  

For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted itself solely to one business: Beauty. Present in 150 countries across five continents and with €42 billion consolidated sales, L'Oréal is the global industry leader. With 37 global beauty brands across four divisions, L’Oréal offers beauty for each covering all beauty categories and catering to all beauty desires. With the acquisition of the Australian brand Aēsop in 2023, the Group continues to expand its portfolio through targeted acquisitions as part of its drive to create the future of beauty.
  
  

Today, L’Oréal includes more than 2,000 tech professionals and is constantly growing. Beauty Tech is changing the game and leading the shift towards new consumer realities and a digital disruption. Championing Beauty Tech, we invent the beauty of the future while becoming the company of the future.
  
  

Beauty Tech is how we know our consumers intimately, augmenting their beauty journeys with unparalleled diverse and sustainable experiences. Beauty Tech equips the Group with the key assets it needs to conquer this new world, where Tech has become strategic. A Day in the Life of Adobe Workfront Fusion Developer!
  
  

L'Oreal is deploying Adobe Workfront globally as the core platform for its Content Adaptation Factories. These factories adapt, localise, and deliver marketing assets at scale across all global markets. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Payroll Tax & Accounting Tech
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you interested in building a high\-performance, globally scalable gross\-to\-net payroll calculation engine with deep tax calculation capabilities that supports Amazon's current and future growth? Are you seeking an environment where you can drive innovation leveraging the scalability and innovation with Amazon's AWS cloud services? Do you have a passion for ensuring accurate financial calculations that directly impact employees? This is the job for you.  

  

Amazon's Payroll Tax \& Accounting Technology team is looking for a results\-oriented, driven Software Development Engineer who can help us create the next generation of distributed, scalable gross\-to\-net calculation infrastructure with sophisticated tax processing at its core. Our ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced environment, enjoys the challenge of highly complex regulatory contexts that are typically being defined in real\-time. We need someone to design and develop a single global system that processes gross earnings through complex multi\-jurisdiction tax calculations to net pay for millions of employees, with local configuration driven by LLM\-based rule extraction.  

  

A Software Development Engineer (SDE) at Amazon works on real world problems on a global scale, owns their systems end to end and influences the direction of our technology that impacts hundreds of millions of customers around the world. You can expect to design flexible and scalable solutions, and work on some of the most complex challenges in large\-scale computing by utilizing your skills in data structures, algorithms, and object oriented programming. Coming to Amazon gives you the opportunity to work on a small development team in one of our many rapidly growing organizations.  

  

You will learn all about how to design, implement and test highly scalable solutions using AWS cloud platform and its many products, in challenging agile projects, working with best in class professionals.  

  

In this role you will:  

  

* Build a globally deployed, locally configured gross\-to\-net calculation engine that leverages LLM\-based rule extraction to formalize complex jurisdiction\-specific tax regulations, including multi\-layered tax calculations, YTD tracking, and statutory compliance requirements
* Design and develop deterministic tax calculation algorithms that handle employee withholding, employer tax obligations, and process gross earnings through deductions to calculate net pay across multiple countries
* Create accounting integration services that generate GL entries and journal entries for all necessary payroll entries, like earnings, tax, \& benefits
* Implement GenAI shadow mode validation frameworks to ensure accuracy against existing systems
* Partner directly with Software Development Engineers (SDEs), Technical Program Managers, tax specialists, and payroll operations teams to understand features and continuously identify opportunities to build and deploy software solutions

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Define high\-level and low\-level design for the global gross\-to\-net calculation engine with complex tax processing capabilities using the latest AWS technology in a large distributed environment
* Take the lead on defining and implementing engineering best practices for deterministic financial calculations and using data to define and improve operational best practices
* Help drive the architecture and technology choices for the LLM\-based rule extraction pipeline and tax\-centric gross\-to\-net calculation products
* Design, develop and deploy medium to large software solutions for Amazon's global payroll tax calculation and gross\-to\-net accounting needs
* Raise the bar on code quality, including security, auditability, readability, consistency, and maintainability
* Leverage GenAI capabilities to build validation frameworks and continuously improve system accuracy

  

A day in the life  

You'll start your morning collaborating with tax specialists and payroll operations teams across multiple countries to understand jurisdiction\-specific requirements. Mid\-day, you'll design and code deterministic tax calculation algorithms, leveraging LLM\-based rule extraction to formalize complex regulations into executable logic. You'll investigate how different countries structure their tax codes, exploring edge cases and regulatory nuances. Afternoons involve implementing shadow mode validation frameworks, reviewing code with your team, and refining accounting integrations. You'll tackle challenges like handling multi\-layered tax calculations, YTD tracking, and ensuring sub\-millisecond performance while maintaining 100% statutory compliance for millions of employees globally.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
* Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
* Knowledge of Machine Learning and LLM fundamentals, including transformer architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization techniques

**Job Description Summary**
 GE Vernova is seeking a strategic, customer\-obsessed Senior Product Manager to lead GridBeats™ Device Management (DvM) — a core component of GridBeats™, our portfolio of software\-defined automation solutions for grid digitalization.
   

  

 GridBeats™ DvM is a powerful software suite enabling remote monitoring, control, and lifecycle management of grid intelligent electronic devices (IEDs) — including protection relays, fault recorders, power quality meters, and sensing equipment. Designed for distribution and transmission utilities, renewable operators, and industrial customers, DvM enhances operational efficiency, cybersecurity, and system resilience.
   

  

 As Senior Product Manager, you will own product strategy, discovery, and delivery — working directly with customers and cross\-functional teams to build solutions that solve real problems, deliver measurable outcomes, and shape the future of grid automation.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Vision \& Strategy**
* Define and own a compelling, outcome\-driven product vision, strategy, and multi\-year roadmap aligned with GridBeats™ business goals.
* Translate market insights and customer problems into prioritized opportunities with measurable business outcomes — not just a list of features.
* Make crisp, well\-reasoned prioritization decisions and align senior stakeholders across product, engineering, sales, and executive leadership.


**Customer \& Market Discovery**
* Conduct continuous customer discovery — engaging operators, protection engineers, and utility leaders to uncover deep pain points and unmet needs.
* Monitor competitive dynamics, regulatory trends (NERC CIP, IEC 61850, IEC 62351\), and technology shifts to inform strategy.
* Represent GE Vernova at industry events and conferences (DistribuTECH, CIGRE, etc.).


**Product Definition \& Delivery**
* Lead the full product lifecycle — from concept and business case through requirements, development, launch, and post\-launch iteration.
* Write crisp, outcome\-focused product artifacts — opportunity canvases, PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria that communicate intent without over\-specifying solutions.
* Work in close collaboration with commercial, engineering, design \& delivery teams.


**Go\-to\-Market \& Sales Enablement**
* Partner with Marketing to develop impactful messaging, collateral, and campaigns across all channels.
* Work with global sales teams to build key customer relationships, execute go\-to\-market strategies, and deliver product training and awareness programs.


**Performance \& Metrics**
* Define and track product KPIs — including adoption, retention, time\-to\-value, financial results, and market share.
* Use quantitative and qualitative evidence to drive decisions and implement continuous improvement or course corrections.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* 10\+ years in product management, including 3\+ years leading industrial or enterprise B2B software products.
* Experience building modern software products using containers and microservices architectures, supporting multiple deployment models (on\-premise, cloud, SaaS).
* Proficiency in data\-driven decision\-making — defining metrics, running analyses, and navigating ambiguity to develop and communicate product strategy.
* Hands\-on experience with modern product innovation methodologies — Product Discovery, Lean Startup, Design Thinking, or similar.
* Familiarity with Agile and other NPI methodologies.
* Ability to work effectively with globally distributed, cross\-functional teams; willingness to travel as required.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Direct experience with electrical utilities, smart grid, device management, protection relays, SCADA, fault recorders, IoT, or industrial protocols (Modbus, DNP3, IEC 61850\).
* Familiarity with AI/ML tools to enhance product management productivity and inform product capabilities

**Desired Characteristics**
* A self\-starter and strategic thinker with a bias for action.
* Customer\-obsessed and passionate about identifying and solving real\-world problems.

* Motivated by the energy transition and its global impact.

jobs.description:
**Product Owner / Product Manager** 




  





 About Company
 



  





 Edvak is a US\-based SaaS company transforming the healthcare sector with our innovative AI solutions. We are dedicated to excellence, creativity, and innovation, delivering exceptional services to our clients. Our operations in India are based in the vibrant city of Hyderabad.
 



 As we continue to expand, we are looking for a dynamic Content Strategist/Marketer to lead our content marketing efforts and drive Edvaks success in a competitive market.
 



  





 Website: www.edvak.com
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 We are looking for a Product Owner / Product Manager who can take business and product requirements and convert them into clear, detailed, and actionable specifications for our design and engineering teams.
 



  





 This person will be responsible for understanding the requirement, documenting how the feature should work, creating process flows and UML diagrams where needed, working closely with the UI/UX designer to finalize designs, and coordinating with engineers during development. The role also includes testing and validating the completed feature to make sure it is developed according to the original requirement.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on product role that requires strong analytical thinking, clear communication, attention to detail, and the ability to work closely with business, design, development, and QA teams.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Understand business requirements, customer needs, and internal product goals.
* Convert high\-level requirements into detailed product specifications.
* Create clear documentation explaining how each feature should work.
* Prepare user stories, acceptance criteria, workflows, and functional requirements.
* Create UML diagrams, process flows, screen flows, and logic diagrams where needed.
* Work with UI/UX designers to explain the requirement and help finalize the design.
* Review designs to make sure they match the expected workflow and requirement.
* Work with engineers to explain the feature behavior, edge cases, validations, and expected outcomes.
* Answer questions from the engineering team during development.
* Coordinate with QA or perform product\-level testing to confirm the feature works as expected.
* Validate that the final developed feature matches the documented requirement and approved design.
* Identify gaps, missing scenarios, workflow issues, or usability concerns before and after development.
* Maintain product documentation and keep requirements updated when changes are made.
* Prioritize tasks and work with leadership to align feature development with product goals.



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Strong understanding of software product development.
* Ability to convert business requirements into clear functional requirements.
* Experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, and product requirement documents.
* Ability to create UML diagrams, workflow diagrams, and process flows.
* Strong communication skills to work with designers, developers, QA, and business teams.
* Good understanding of UI/UX workflows and user\-friendly software design.
* Ability to think through edge cases, validations, user permissions, and system behavior.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to test features and confirm that they match the requirement.
* Ability to manage multiple features and priorities at the same time.
* Comfortable working in an Agile development environment.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* Experience working with SaaS products, healthcare software, EHR, practice management, billing, or patient engagement platforms.
* Experience working with tools such as Jira, ClickUp, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Figma, Lucidchart, Draw.io, or similar tools.
* Basic understanding of databases, APIs, integrations, and system workflows.
* Experience working with AI\-enabled software features is a plus.
* Experience working with remote or distributed engineering teams.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Healthcare IT, or a related field preferred.
* 3\+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role.
* Prior experience in a software product company is preferred.
* Healthcare technology experience is a strong plus.



  





**Success in This Role Looks Like** 




  




* Requirements are clearly documented before development starts.
* Designers and engineers understand exactly how the feature should work.
* Important edge cases and workflow gaps are identified early.
* Designs match the intended feature behavior.
* Developed features match the requirement with minimal rework.
* QA and development teams have clear acceptance criteria for testing.
* Product delivery becomes smoother, faster, and more organized.

**Mission** 
 : Your goal is to transform "studying" into an immersive, AI\-driven experience that students want to return to. You won’t just be managing a roadmap; you’ll be orchestrating the entire user's lifecycle to drive industry\-leading Retention and Renewal rates.

 As a leader in the engagement pod, your focus is on the "Stickiness" of the platform. You will manage a team to execute across these pillars:
 


* **Multi\-Cohort Strategy Design:**
* **K\-5 (Skill Building):** 
 Develop high\-trust, parent\-gated interfaces and gamified reward systems that foster a love for learning.

 Bridge the gap between school curriculum and after school engagement using interactive modules and peer\-based engagement triggers.
* **11\-12 (Test Prep):** 
 Build high\-velocity, high\-utility tools for JEE/NEET aspirants where time\-to\-value and precision are the only metrics that matter.

* Drive sprint execution and ensure timely shipping of high impact releases — work with engineering managers, QA, design, and content teams to plan, prioritize, unblock, and deliver features on time.
* **AI\-Native Product Evolution:**
* Architect AI\-driven "Nudge Engines" predicts when a student is likely to drop off and intervene with personalized content.
* Integrate LLM\-based workflows to reduce friction in the learning journey.
* **Full\-Funnel Journey Mapping:**
* Define the "Golden Path" for every user persona from Day 0 (Onboarding) to Day 365 (Renewal).
* Identify bottlenecks in the usage funnel and deploy A/B tests to optimize conversion at every milestone.
* **Data Driven Approach \& Impact Analysis:**
* Evaluate how engagement features impact the
 **Upstream** 
 (Sales/Marketing efficiency) and
 **Downstream** 
 (Learning outcomes/Exam results).
* Ensure that increasing "Time Spent" doesn't lead to "Burnout," maintaining a healthy balance between usage and actual learning progress for users.
* **People Leadership:**
* Lead a team of Product Managers and Associate Product Managers, fostering a culture of data\-backed experimentation and first\-principles thinking.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Design, and Content teams to ensure the roadmap is technically feasible and pedagogically sound.



  





**Expected Skills \& Expertise** 



* **Product Mastery:**
* Expertise in
 **Retention Loops** 
 and
 **Behavioral Design** 
 (Hook Model, Gamification, and Nudge Theory).
* Ability to translate complex user psychology (parent vs. student vs. aspirant) into intuitive UI/UX.
* **AI \& Technical Depth:**
* Proficiency in leveraging
 **Generative AI** 
 and
 **Agentic AI** 
 to create personalized user experiences.
* Strong understanding of data architecture—knowing how data flows between systems to ensure accurate and in\-dept metric\-based tracking.
* **Data \& Analytics:**
* Power\-user of analytics and product marketing tools.
* Ability to conduct deep\-dive cohort analysis and present insights that drive executive\-level decisions.



  





**Candidate Profile** 



* **7\+ years** 
 in Product Management, with at least 2 years leading teams in high\-scale B2C environments (EdTech, Gaming, or Consumer Tech).
* **Education:** 
 B.Tech (CS/IT preferred) from a
 **Tier\-1 institute (IIT/BITS/NIT)** 
 .



**Behavioral** 



* **Resilient \& Adaptable:** 
 You thrive in the chaos of a growing company.
* **Empathetic:** 
 You can step into the shoes of a 7\-year\-old and an 18\-year\-old in the same hour.
* **Extreme Ownership:** 
 You don't just ship features; you own the outcome. You treat the product like your own company.



**Problem Solving** 



* High "Figure\-it\-out" quotient. You treat every friction point as a puzzle, not a roadblock.

jobs.description:
**About Persistent**
 We are an AI\-led, platform\-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry\-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.
   

  

 Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654\.4M FY26 revenue with 17\.4% Y\-o\-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436\.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3\.2% Q\-o\-Q and 16\.2% Y\-o\-Y growth. Our 27,500\+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026\.
   

  

**About Position**
 We are hiring a Product Owner with strong Lending (LOS) domain expertise to drive product vision, prioritize features, and lead Agile delivery. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate business needs into impactful solutions, ensuring seamless product execution and enhanced customer experience in a fast\-paced fintech environment. Please mention a brief description of the position.
   

  

* Role: Product Owner
* Location: Any PSL Location
* Experience: 6 to 10 Years
* Job Type: Full Time Employment


**What You'll Do**
* Assess business value, develop business cases, and prioritize epics, stories, and themes aligned with product vision and strategic goals.
* Define and manage product deliveries, release plans, and feature scope in collaboration with platform leadership.
* Draft product objectives and strategies, leveraging data\-driven insights for decision\-making.
* Define and track KPIs; utilize analytics, A/B testing, and user feedback to refine product features.
* Convert functional specifications into actionable user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
* Own, maintain, and refine the product backlog; lead backlog grooming and sprint planning sessions.
* Manage release planning and track progress through development and QA phases in collaboration with the Scrum Master.
* Lead software gate reviews, including formal and informal handoffs.
* Collaborate with stakeholders on product visioning and concept development.
* Translate complex sprint outcomes and technical updates into business\-friendly summaries.
* Act as the voice of the customer across engineering, UX, QA, and business teams.
* Proactively identify and escalate risks and impediments to program leadership.
* Ensure understanding of end\-to\-end customer experience, integrations, and technical dependencies.
* Drive continuous improvement in product development practices.
* Thrive in a collaborative, team\-oriented culture with shared accountability.


**Expertise You'll Bring**
* Experience working as a Product Owner or in a similar role within software product development.
* Strong domain knowledge in Lending (LOS mandatory) and familiarity with LMS systems.
* Solid understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban); SAFe experience is a plus.
* Proven ability to write clear user stories and translate business requirements into technical specifications.
* Hands\-on experience collaborating with engineering, QA, UX, and cross\-functional teams.
* Product Owner certification preferred; Scrum Master certification is an added advantage.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* Advanced English communication skills (B2\+ or higher).
* Prior experience in FinTech is a plus.


**Benefits**
* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company\-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check\-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents


**Values\-Driven, People\-Centric \& Inclusive Work Environment**
 Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.
   

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility\-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

jobs.description:
**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a visionary and highly experienced
 **Director, CashIn‑ Engineering Partner** 
 to lead the engineering strategy, delivery, and transformation for all cashin/Order to Cash‑ processes across the Group. This role will own the engineering agenda across complex billing, rating, charging, and invoicing platforms—driving the next generation of our billing landscape while ensuring operational excellence today.
   

  

 The ideal leader will bring deep hands\-on technical expertise‑ in
 **Oracle Revenue Management \& Billing (ORMB)** 
 , strong familiarity with
 **SAP SD** 
 , and experience across adjacent billing ecosystems. They will spearhead our multi‑year
 **Billing Transformation Programme** 
 , building a world‑class engineering capability that delivers scalable architectures, modern engineering practices, and measurable business outcomes.
   

  

 This is a critical leadership position that partners across Engineering, Finance, Commercial, and Product to elevate the Group’s cashin capability and ensure we remain future‑ fit‑.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Leadership**
* Define and execute the engineering strategy for all cash\-in, billing, rating, and revenue‑ ‑related platforms across the Group.
* Serve as the single engineering owner for ORMB, SAP SD, and associated billing systems.
* Lead the design and implementation of the Group\-wide Billing Transformation Programme, modernising legacy platforms into scalable, modular, cloud\-ready‑ architectures.
* Establish long\-term roadmaps aligned with Finance, Group Commercial, Enterprise Billing, and Engineering strategies.


**Engineering Delivery \& Oversight**
* Lead engineering teams responsible for build, integration, testing, release, and operations of all cash‑in platforms.
* Drive modern engineering practices including CI/CD, DevSecOps, API\-driven‑ design, automated testing, platform reliability, and cloud adoption.
* Ensure engineering solutions deliver high performance, reliability, regulatory compliance, and financial accuracy.
* Oversee vendor partners, system integrators, and engineering suppliers, ensuring quality and accountability.


**Transformation \& Innovation**
* Champion simplification and rationalisation of the cash‑in landscape, reducing technical debt and accelerating time‑to‑market.
* Introduce modern billing and charging capabilities including real‑time processing, microservices‑based architectures, and event\-driven integrations.
* Drive continuous improvement, performance optimisation, and cost efficiency across platforms.


**Stakeholder Partnership**
* Act as the strategic engineering partner to Finance, Commercial, and Product teams—aligning platform capabilities with business needs.
* Communicate engineering decisions and architectural direction to senior leaders and executive forums.
* Build trusted relationships with vendors, engineering partners, and Group stakeholders.


**People Leadership**
* Build, lead, and inspire a high‑performing, diverse engineering organisation.
* Develop talent, upskill teams, and embed a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and innovation.
* Foster a collaborative, open, engineering culture across Group teams and OpCos.


**Key Skills \& Experience**
**Technical Expertise**
* Mandatory: Hands‑on, deep experience with Oracle Revenue Management \& Billing (ORMB) including configuration, integration patterns, data models, and customisation approaches.
* Strong familiarity / conversant with: SAP SD, including convergent charging, convergent invoicing, subscription order management, and integration architecture.
* Experience with billing platforms such as Keylight, Zuora, Amdocs, Netcracker, or similar (advantageous).
* Strong understanding of revenue processes, payment flows, credit management, and financial compliance requirements.
* Experience building cloud\-native solutions and transforming monolithic billing systems to modern architectures (e.g., microservices, APIs, event\-based billing).


**Leadership \& Delivery**
* Proven ability to lead engineering organisations, multi\-vendor teams, and large transformation programs.
* Demonstrated success in driving platform transformation or modernisation in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong capability to define roadmaps, manage budgets, and influence senior stakeholders.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, especially with Finance and Commercial executives.


**Qualifications**
* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related discipline.
* Advanced certifications in enterprise architecture, cloud, or billing systems beneficial.
* 10\+ years in senior engineering leadership roles, ideally in billing, revenue, or finance tech‑ domains.


**What We Offer**
* Opportunity to lead one of the most significant strategic transformations across the Group.
* A platform to build a world‑class engineering capability shaping the future of our revenue and billing foundations.
* Collaborative culture with executive visibility and impact.

**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**Role overview**

  

Crowe’s Microsoft Consulting Practice is hiring an Agentic Business Process Analyst to help clients rethink how work gets done in the AI era. This is not a traditional business analyst role focused only on documenting requirements, writing user stories, or mapping current\-state processes. This role is for someone who can diagnose business problems, understand root causes, redesign processes, and identify where AI agents, automation, data, and human judgment should come together.

  

The ideal candidate is deeply functional, process\-oriented, and comfortable enough with technology to work side by side with engineers, architects, and client IT teams. This person should be able to bridge business and technology, helping clients move from legacy workflows to intelligent, agent\-enabled processes.

  

This role also has an internal transformation mandate. The person will help upskill Crowe Consulting teams that may be used to traditional ERP, CRM, or business application delivery. They will help consultants develop a more modern mindset: start with problems, then processes, then technology.

 **What you will do**

* Lead discovery sessions with clients to understand business goals, pain points, process breakdowns, data issues, user needs, controls, and operating constraints.

* Diagnose root causes across people, process, data, and technology before recommending solutions.
* Identify opportunities for AI assistance, agentic augmentation, workflow orchestration, automation, knowledge retrieval, decision support, and process improvement.
* Partner with technical architects and engineers to translate process opportunities into solution designs, prototypes, functional specifications, user stories, and delivery roadmaps.

* Support workshops, demos, process redesign sessions, executive presentations, and change management conversations.

* Coach Crowe consultants on how to move beyond legacy requirements gathering into diagnostic, value\-led, AI\-enabled transformation work.

* You can walk into a messy client process and make sense of it quickly.
* You can separate symptoms from root causes.
* You know when the right answer is process redesign, data cleanup, integration, training, governance, automation, or AI.
* You can help clients and internal teams understand what agents should do, what humans should do, and how to measure whether the new process is better.
* You make technical teams sharper by giving them better process context, and you make business teams more confident by helping them understand what technology can realistically do.

 **Required experience**

* 6 or more years of experience as a business analyst, functional consultant, process consultant, product owner, transformation consultant, or similar role.
* Strong experience mapping, analyzing, and redesigning business processes.
* Experience working on enterprise technology implementations, preferably involving Microsoft Dynamics 365, CRM, ERP, Power Platform, data platforms, workflow automation, or related business applications.
* Ability to facilitate workshops with business users, technical teams, and senior stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of process metrics, business value measurement, operational KPIs, and adoption measures.
* Ability to write clear functional requirements, user stories, process flows, acceptance criteria, solution narratives, and executive\-ready recommendations.
* Comfort working with technical teams on AI, automation, data, integration, and system design topics.
* Ability to mentor other consultants and help teams adopt new ways of working.

 **Preferred experience**

* Experience with Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, Customer Insights, Project Operations, Finance, or Supply Chain.
* Experience with Power Platform, Copilot Studio, process mining, business process catalogs, customer journey mapping, service design, or operating model transformation.

* Experience in consulting or professional services.
* Exposure to responsible AI, governance, risk, compliance, controls, or regulated industry environments.

The Product and IT teams at Medtronic collaborate to deliver innovative solutions that align with business strategy and drive meaningful outcomes.

You will translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements, enabling seamless collaboration across stakeholders and driving execution across the product development lifecycle.

jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  

As a member of the Optum Insight Product (OI Product) division, you will play a key role in advancing administrative, financial, and clinical processes through software\-enabled services, cloud platforms, and data science. Our team's vision is to harness cloud technology, machine learning, and innovative analytics to simplify healthcare complexity and improve patient outcomes across the health system. In this role, you will support and manage the end\-to\-end product lifecycle for data science and cloud\-focused products. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define product strategy, maintain a robust product roadmap, and act as a critical bridge between business stakeholders and technical execution teams.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Support and manage the end\-to\-end product lifecycle for healthcare\-focused data science, cloud, and analytical product initiatives
* Collaborate with engineering, architecture, and business leaders to define product strategy and maintain a detailed, forward\-looking product roadmap
* Act as a Product Owner/Analyst by defining, grooming, and prioritizing the product backlog, ensuring alignment with overall business objectives
* Translate complex business and healthcare operations needs into detailed technical requirements, user stories, and clear acceptance criteria
* Evaluate emerging trends, industry standards, and innovative technologies to inform solution design and strategic product innovation
* Design, develop, and deploy AI\-powered solutions to address complex business challenges with emphasis on responsible use of AI
* Leverage enterprise\-approved AI tools to streamline product management workflows, automate tasks, and drive continuous improvement
* Collaborate with cross\-functional partners to execute product launches, support user adoption, and measure product performance
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree (Full\-time) or equivalent experience (e.g., 4\+ years of experience in product management, product analysis, or a related technology field in lieu of a degree)
* 3\+ years of experience in product management, product analysis, or product ownership within a software development, technology, or healthcare organization
* 2\+ years of experience working with cloud\-based platforms (such as Azure, AWS, or GCP) or cloud\-native software products

 **must have** 
 ):

 Qualifications
 



**From Policy Admin Vantage side below are the technical skill sets which we are expecting candidate to have** 




  





  





 Functional Area
 



 Details
 



 Post Issue Life Cycle
 



 Should have a detailed understanding of the post issuance life cycle process:
 


* Should have detailed understanding of the different transactions
* Policy Add (EA)
* Remittance/Premiums (NA,MA)
* Surrenders (TA), Withdrawals (TB,TW)
* Payouts (TK)
* Loans Processing (TL). Different Kinds of Loans ( Participating, Non Participating, ZIL etc.)
* Lapse Pending , Lapse , Paid UP etc
* Different Kinds of Disability/ Waiver Claims (Waiver Of Premium, Waiver Of COI, LTC etc.)
* Death Claim (DP, PA and DBA) etc. etc.
* Basic Understanding of Minimum Required distribution RMD (US), 2 Pot Withdrawals (South Africa) i.e. understanding of early withdrawal concepts for retirement products etc. etc.



  





 The Candidate should have proper understanding of above transactions for example for surrender and withdrawals they should have understanding of surrender charge/Penalty Rules(How they are driven based on Business Rules Tables) , Rules For Free Amount etc.
 



  





 Differences between Lapse Pending , Lapse , Paid Up should have comprehension skills to understand different rules
 



  





 What is the difference between Cost Of Insurance , Rider Fee, Benefit Charges, Premium Load etc.
 



  





  





 Business Rules Tables
 



 Life and Annuity Policy Admin Systems like Vantage , WMA ,ALIP etc are driven around business rules instead of Hard Coding. In Vantage there are various db2/VSAM (In Old Instance Of Vantage) Tables where the Business Rules are defined instead of doing hard coding. Few examples are:
 


* What are the business rules tables to set up a new product /Plan code (Ex T03,T04 etc). How the relational logic works
* How are different Declared Interest Rates , Guranteed Rates determined for Fixed ,Money Market Funds etc.
* How are the admin charges ,rider charges defined. For Example there is one table T33 which defines the admin charges to administer fiffrent transactions like
* Surrenders
* Withdrawals.
* Loans
* Annuity Payouts
* Paid Up (Reduced Coverage) Charges etc



  





 Note: It is not mandatory for the Candidate to know all the Tables since these tables are highly customized/and vary on the versions of vantage instance and also vary on what kind of products Insurance carrier have. But they should have a reasonable understanding of how the business rule table works and they should be able to explain it how they have used it in their previous projects with different clients

**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
   

  

**Job Description:**
**Role Overview**
 Crowe’s Microsoft Consulting Practice is hiring an Agentic Business Process Analyst to help clients rethink how work gets done in the AI era. This is not a traditional business analyst role focused only on documenting requirements, writing user stories, or mapping current\-state processes. This role is for someone who can diagnose business problems, understand root causes, redesign processes, and identify where AI agents, automation, data, and human judgment should come together.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is deeply functional, process\-oriented, and comfortable enough with technology to work side by side with engineers, architects, and client IT teams. This person should be able to bridge business and technology, helping clients move from legacy workflows to intelligent, agent\-enabled processes.
   

  

 This role also has an internal transformation mandate. The person will help upskill Crowe Consulting teams that may be used to traditional ERP, CRM, or business application delivery. They will help consultants develop a more modern mindset: start with problems, then processes, then technology.

* Diagnose root causes across people, process, data, and technology before recommending solutions.
* Identify opportunities for AI assistance, agentic augmentation, workflow orchestration, automation, knowledge retrieval, decision support, and process improvement.

* Coach Crowe consultants on how to move beyond legacy requirements gathering into diagnostic, value\-led, AI\-enabled transformation work.

* You can walk into a messy client process and make sense of it quickly.
* You can separate symptoms from root causes.
* You know when the right answer is process redesign, data cleanup, integration, training, governance, automation, or AI.
* You can help clients and internal teams understand what agents should do, what humans should do, and how to measure whether the new process is better.
* You make technical teams sharper by giving them better process context, and you make business teams more confident by helping them understand what technology can realistically do.

* Ability to write clear functional requirements, user stories, process flows, acceptance criteria, solution narratives, and executive\-ready recommendations.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Amazon Alexa Automotive team is looking for a product leader to help drive our Alexa Custom Assistant (ACA) product — our Auto OEM\-centric product offering a custom branded version of our LLM\-powered Alexa experience. We’re looking for a PM to lead the definition and delivery of our LLM\-powered products and automation enablers, allowing for us to scale our ACA offering across multiple global OEMs.  

  

Our ideal candidate will have launched multiple, impactful products, and have deep understanding of product management, user experience, partner integration and development tooling, system design and software development, and partner management. You should be analytical, able to work and influence cross\-functionally across multiple business units, and thrive in entrepreneurial, fast\-paced environments.
  

  

Experience in automotive infotainment, voice, partner integration tooling, and/or billing systems is a plus but not a must\-have (we welcome product managers from diverse backgrounds to our team as they bring fresh perspectives to our products). AI fluency is highly encouraged.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Key job responsibilities  

  

* Operate as PM lead on the projects where we work to help our OEM partners accelerate their time to market for our ACA product through LLM\-enabled tooling and automations (docs, support tickets, test externalization, billing, etc.)
* Auto PM lead for our suite of Agent creation and integration tooling in partnership with AWS
* Own a suite of our automotive custom / personalized voice enabler products
* Define and drive delivery targets and operational excellence for your products
* \-
* Lead product strategy and delivery in a customer and partner obsessed manner.
* Define creative, high quality product requirements and roadmaps based on product strategy.
* Manage prioritization and trade\-offs among customer experience, performance \& operational support requirements.
* Create buy\-in for product vision across internal partner teams as well as external OEM partners (incl senior leaders)
* Work closely with science / engineering teams to deliver products to market using agile development methodologies.
* Identify and resolve issues that may impair the team’s ability to meet strategic, financial, and technical goals

  

A day in the life  

You will drive requirements and execution of features and experiences for our Automotive ScaleX product and enablers, with a focus on scaling our ACA product. You will own product vision, synthesize customer and business requirements into product roadmaps, and launch new features from start to finish. You will be a champion of this product both internally to senior leadership as well as externally to the industry. You will work in close collaboration with internal stakeholders and external strategic OEM partners, operating as product owner for these major strategic launches. You’ll sell\-in your vision, collaborate on requirements, prioritize delivery, make strategic recommendations, and hold everybody to a high standard of excellence. A successful candidate will have a passion for designing delightful customer experiences, strong partner skills, and the entrepreneurial grit to get things done!  

  

About the team  

Our team’s mission is to provide delightful, LLM\-powered assistant experiences to our automotive customers. Our automotive products lead the way in delivering next generation in\-vehicle digital experiences with the goal of reducing friction in our customers' lives, and helping to delight and simplify along the way. We look for people who will push us to get better, and are constructive in finding solutions to tough problems.  

  

This is a highly cross\-functional product leadership role with the opportunity to influence across multiple organizations within Alexa and Devices \& Services business.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive\-level prioritization and planning

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools
* Experience in B2B, high\-tech products/services preferred
* Experience with strong project management skills and the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment
* 5\+ years of end to end product delivery experience
* Experience completing complex tasks quickly with little to no guidance and react with appropriate urgency to situations that require a quick turnaround, or experience in senior level leadership support

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. jobs.description:
* Role: Product Manager
* Location: Bengaluru (HSR Layout)
* Type: Full\-time
* Experience: 2–4 years



  





**About the role**




 We're building an AI interviewer that runs real candidate interviews on behalf of hiring teams —
 



 combining natural conversation, structured evaluation, and evidence\-based judgment. It serves three
 



 demanding audiences at once: candidates, who need it to feel fair and human; customers —
 



 recruiters, hiring managers, internal TA teams — who need it to be reliable and defensible; and
 



 internal teams, who need to ship fast without dropping quality.
 



***We're looking for a PM to own parts of this product end\-to\-end — from shaping what we build next, to working directly with customers and candidates, to partnering with engineering, design, and product operations to ship it.***




 We're a small, early\-stage team, so this comes with a lot of ownership and almost no pre\-existing
 



 process — you'll be building the playbook as much as running one.
 



  





**What you'll do**




 Product ownership
 


* Own product areas end\-to\-end — define problems, write specs, prioritise the roadmap, and ship



 features for the AI interviewer experience.
 



  





 Customer \& candidate discovery
 


* Talk to customers regularly — recruiters, hiring managers, TA leaders — to learn how their first



 interview round runs and where their bar is, then turn that into product requirements.
 


* Understand the candidate side of the table — experience, fairness, clear expectations, and how



 people behave differently talking to an AI than to a human.
 



  





 AI \& quality
 


* Lead AI features — scope what's feasible, design prompts, review model behaviour and outputs,



 and iterate on interview quality: question design, follow\-up logic, scoring, edge cases.
 


* Define and track quality metrics for a product where "quality" is inherently fuzzy.
* Run structured experiments — A/B tests, design\-partner pilots, phased rollouts — to validate



 changes before they go broad.
 



  





 Cross\-functional execution
 


* Work across the org — founders, sales, customer success, engineering, L2 support, recruitment



 services, and product operations — to get things shipped.
 



  





  





**What we're looking for**




 We're looking for a PM with 2–4 years of experience who has owned real product outcomes — not just
 



 written tickets. Ideally you've taken at least one feature or product area from problem definition
 



 through launch and iteration.
 



  




* Hands\-on with GenAI/LLMs — you've written and iterated on prompts, and you judge output quality



 beyond "does it work": is it good, is it consistent, where does it break? You reach for eval
 



 frameworks and rubrics rather than judging by feel.
 


* Strong data analysis — you pull and slice data yourself (SQL and/or spreadsheets), define metrics



 for a fuzzy quality space, and use data, not just intuition, to make and defend calls.
 


* A "whatever it takes to ship" mentality — you're not precious about "my job." If shipping means



 writing test cases, doing hands\-on QA on interview transcripts, building a stopgap tool, or getting
 



 into product operations, you do it rather than wait.
 


* Strong customer\-facing instincts — you're comfortable running discovery calls, sitting in on pilots,



 and turning fuzzy feedback into concrete product decisions.
 


* Comfort with ambiguity — there's no established process to lean on, priorities shift as you learn,



 and you'll often define your own scope rather than have it handed to you.
 



  





**Nice to have**



* A technical background — you've written code before (even if you're not an engineer today), or



 you're happy getting into engineering concepts to understand technical interviews deeply.
 


* Shipped AI/LLM products — experience building AI/LLM\-powered products in a previous PM role.
* Prototyping with AI tools — experience using AI tools to build quick prototypes.



  





**About Geektrust**




 Geektrust started in 2015 on a simple conviction: developers should be hired on real skill, not a resume or a pedigree. That belief became a skill\-first hiring platform trusted by 750\+ companies — from high\-growth startups like Zomato to global enterprises like Tesco. Founded by alumni of ThoughtWorks and ESPN, we've spent a decade at the intersection of human judgment and AI, and we're growing 50–75% this year across an 85\-member team.
 



  





 Our business runs on two lines: Geektrust Recruit — contract\-to\-hire and placement — and Assemble,
 



 our AI\-driven technical interview product. The AI interviewer this role helps build sits right at the centre of a problem we've spent a decade obsessing over.

JPM Personal Investing is the UK's largest truly digital wealth manager, offering clarity and transparency to both seasoned and first\-time investors as they seek to achieve their financial goals. through the powerful combination of an easy\-to\-use, adaptable investment service and market\-leading human guidance and advice. JPM Personal Investing is a J.P. Morgan company offering investments and digital wealth management services to consumers, complementing Chase's digital bank in the UK.


As an Application Owner within the Engineering Operations Team, you will be responsible for technology asset management, vendor onboarding and compliance with technology controls.


Do you enjoy building relationships, managing projects, compliance, problem solving \& managing vendors? We are seeking a candidate who can flex from being strategic to tactical, and from being creative to pragmatic and analytical. To join our team, you will need to have an interest in technology controls, software and vendor onboarding as well as a desire for learning how technology operates. You will act as the primary liaison between our engineering teams, business and vendors. Your responsibilities will include overseeing documenting and evidencing existing application architecture and data flows, identifying compliance gaps, and ensuring gaps are converted to actionable engineering requirements for prioritization.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Source context and information from the Technology Teams and software vendors to execute the software onboarding process.
* Work with Global Supplier Services to onboard and monitor vendors
* Build and manage relationships with internal key stakeholders and contacts to ensure legal, risk, compliance and/or controls requirements are satisfied
* Partner with our product and engineering teams to ensure technology meets the needs of the business.
* Act as a subject matter expert. Maintaining knowledge of software functionality, software architecture, onboarding processes, company procedures and technology controls as well as any changes to the standards.
* Engage with senior stakeholders across the firm to agree priority and resolve issues, risks and areas of contention.
* Collaborate with Technology Owners and Internal Governance to identify areas of software onboarding risk, share pertinent information and problem solve.
* Understand the architecture for the wider JPM Personal Investing ecosystem.
* Identify opportunities to eliminate or automate remediation of recurring issues to improve compliance with technology controls

**Required qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* 5\+ years of professional experience
* Strong interpersonal and influencing skills – ability to manage senior stakeholders whilst dealing with competing priorities.
* Clear communications skills, both written and verbal.
* Highly organized, proactive and detail\-oriented.
* Possess a can\-do, problem solving attitude and time management discipline.
* Ability to understand technical concepts
* Overall knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle
* Familiarity with Cloud Architecture, implementation of digital products, SaaS and DevOps.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Experience with third party risk oversight/sourcing/vendor management

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
 The Agile Product Owner will be responsible for owning the product backlog, including communicating the end user requirements, defining user acceptance criteria for requirements, and prioritizing and managing the backlog. The role represents the “voice of the customer”, ensuring that the team is working on stories that maximize business value and deliver necessary functionality to our customers. The individual will work with multiple stakeholders to determine the business and technology objectives for their team and ensure solutions deliver tangible business value.
   

  

 The role is responsible for Cigna's Global Health Benefits external customer app / portal digital experience. In collaboration with product owners across the release train, the team is accountable to drive the objectives for enhancing customer digital experiences, and ensuring technology platform optimization.
   

  

 The Product Owner will be responsible for understanding internal stakeholders and end users deeply and must synthesize information from multiple sources to ensure backlog readiness and quality. The individual must exercise considerable creativity, foresight, and judgment in conceiving, planning, and delivering initiatives. Ideal candidate must possess a broad base of skills and knowledge spanning technology, the individual health insurance business, user experience design, and agile development practices. In collaboration with the Product Manager, the individual will act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technology to set business objectives, communicate capability requirements, and establish roadmaps based on business priorities and optimizing value.
   

  

 The role will collaborate closely with the Scrum Master and UX / UI experts to guide the teams towards successful delivery. The Product Owner will decompose features into user stories for the development team and has ownership over ensuring stories are prioritize and planned to optimize pace and value within the Program Increment. Individual will also work closely with Change Readiness, Subject Matter Experts, and Key Stakeholders to ensure business areas are ready for the changes as capabilities are developed and released to end users.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Collaborates with stakeholders to ensure alignment between business strategy and product development efforts
* Collaborates with Product Manager and Portfolio Managers to ensure backlogs align to business and product roadmaps
* Has final decision\-making authority on acceptance criteria for product functions
* Maintains and refines the inflow of work to the team (product backlog)
* Responsible for decomposing features into user stories and acceptance criteria
* Ensures stories clearly communicate customer/stakeholder needs to the Scrum team; work with team to clarify stories as necessary
* Sets and communicates the team’s scope for the current iteration
* Assesses business value and prioritizes all stories to ensure work focuses on those with maximum value and aligns with strategy
* Collaborate with UX/UI teams to ensure the customer voice is embedded at all stages of the product delivery cycle
* Partners with the Product Managers by contributing to story mapping and brainstorming activities to prepare and decompose work for teams
* Ensures the outcome and value is clearly defined and communicated to support technical assessments of solutions with the development team
* Works closely with cross\-functional teams to validate product hypotheses and make data\-informed decisions
* Must be aware of other work being completed within the Release Train so that they can help teams proactively manage risks and dependencies and propose optimal solutions
* Understands and supports inter\-team dependencies and escalates prioritization issues when necessary
* Clearly communicates release timing and delivery dates to Product Management, Portfolio Leads and Key Stakeholders
* Works closely with their Scrum Master to understand progress to plan, identify blockers and paths to resolution
* Reports outward on progress against PI objectives and is accountable for JIRA reporting quality
* Supports UAT and business readiness activities to ensure new capabilities deliver expected value for internal and external stakeholders


**Required Skills And Experience**
* Agile Product Owner experience 3\+ years required
* Experience in individual health insurance industry preferred
* Bachelor’s Degree required
* Strong English language skills required
* Knowledge of agile methodology required
* Experience working in JIRA tool or an equivalent preferred
* Both technically deep and business savvy enough to interface with cross\-functional partners
* Proven ability to develop strong working relationships and establish a high level of credibility across functional and lines of business
* High attention to detail and proven ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously
* Demonstrates strong decision\-making skills and problem\-solving techniques
* Demonstrates ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team in a fast paced and changing environment
* Strong adaptive capability; ability to approach problems pragmatically and creatively in the phase of changing circumstances, resources and direction
* Strong analytical skills and proficiency in using data to inform product decisions and measure success
* Some degree of flexibility to work with International Health stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones


**About The Cigna Group**
 Cigna Healthcare, a division of The Cigna Group, is an advocate for better health through every stage of life. We guide our customers through the health care system, empowering them with the information and insight they need to make the best choices for improving their health and vitality. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

jobs.description:
**Level Up Your Career with Zynga!**



At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play. As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take\-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times—connecting players in 175\+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.



From thrilling casino spins to epic strategy battles, mind\-bending puzzles, and social word challenges, our diverse game portfolio has something for everyone. Fan\-favorites and latest hits include FarmVille™, Words With Friends™, Zynga Poker™, Game of Thrones Slots Casino™, Wizard of Oz Slots™, Hit it Rich! Slots™, Wonka Slots™, Top Eleven™, Toon Blast™, Empires \& Puzzles™, Merge Dragons!™, CSR Racing™, Harry Potter: Puzzles \& Spells™, Match Factory™, and Color Block Jam™—plus many more!

 Zynga's data science and analytics team uses our unique and expansive data to model and predict user behavior, making our games more personalized and more fun to play! * Implement novel analytical methodologies (statistical modeling, ML, causal inference, etc.) and advocate for their adoption across the broader analytics organization

* Drive and empower game studios to make quantitatively informed, evidence\-based decisions through scalable source\-of\-truth data platforms, frameworks, and dashboards
* Lead the design, testing, verification, and implementation of machine learning models and product features within Zynga's games that impact millions of users
* Champion best practices in experimentation, data governance, and analytical reproducibility org\-wide

  


**What You Bring :**


* BS in Computer Science, Math, Statistics, Economics, or other quantitative field; Masters, MBA, or PhD strongly preferred
* 8\+ years of work experience in data science or analytics roles, with progressive increases in scope and impact
* Fluent in SQL; strong programming skills in Python; adept in atleast one visualization tools such as Tableau, Looker, or equivalent
* Deep expertise in statistics, experimental design, causal inference, machine learning, and/or deep learning — with a track record of production\-scale deployment
* Extensive experience analyzing large datasets
* Proven track record of leading complex, ambiguous, cross\-functional initiatives from problem framing through production impact, with minimal direction
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior leadership and drive org\-wide strategic change through data
* Experience mentoring and growing other data scientists and analysts
* Proven ability to define analytics strategy or build analytics capabilities from the ground up
* Exceptional written and oral communication skills — able to translate complex analysis into clear, actionable narratives for executive audiences
* Ability to operate with high autonomy in ambiguous, complex problem spaces with minimal direction
* Ability to collaborate effectively across disciplines — engineering, product, design, marketing, and studio leadership — to deliver unambiguous business impact
* Strong passion for gaming!

  


**Bonus Points :**


Experience in gaming, mobile, or consumer tech industries.

  


**What We Offer You** :



Zynga offers a world\-class benefits package that helps support and balance the needs of our teams. To find out more about our benefits, visit the Zynga Benefits

The candidate manages topology configurations, deployment execution, and program ticket governance for the Amazon Now network. This role requires strong attention to detail, strong analytical acumen, and the ability to manage high\-volume deployment pipelines while ensuring zero\-defect configuration accuracy across a rapidly scaling store network.

1\. Own end\-to\-end topology configuration workflows\- including store attribute setup, service area mapping, fulfillment channel configurations, and go\-live readiness validation across all launch workstreams  

2\. Manage deployment tickets from intake through closure prioritizing based on business criticality, ensuring correct sequencing, and tracking SLA adherence across all open items  

3\. Execute configuration deployments with zero\-defect accuracy validating inputs against SOPs, running pre\-deployment checks, and confirming post\-deployment health before sign\-off  

4\. Use analytical tools (Excel, SQL, internal dashboards) to audit configuration integrity, identify deployment anomalies, and generate compliance reports that flag deviations before they become customer\-impacting  

5\. Maintain real\-time visibility on deployment pipeline health — tracking open vs. closed tickets, aging items, blocked dependencies, and surfacing risks proactively with supporting data  

6\. Coordinate with cross\-functional teams (operations, tech, vendor management, site launch) to unblock configuration dependencies and ensure deployment timelines are not breached  

7\. Build and maintain documentation for configuration standards, deployment and exception\-handling playbooks to enable consistency at scale

------------------------

* 1\+ years of data analytics or automation experience
* 1\+ years of capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or similar experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of data pipelining and extraction using SQL
* Knowledge of SQL and Excel at a moderate or advanced level
* Experience with data mining tools like SQL, SAS, SPSS, or similar
